error_message: condition task prompt digest does not match the registered value
root_cause: After the snapshot-decode adapter passed the registered snapshot audit, the frozen analyzer compared each immutable run result's digest of stripped CRLF prompt text with the registered digest of stripped LF-canonical prompt text. The runner and registration builder therefore bound different newline semantics to the same field name.
resolution: Preserved this failed replay and extended the post-hoc adapter to reverify the exact registered prompt bytes and LF-canonical digest before validating the immutable condition result against the runner's legacy stripped-CRLF digest. The frozen analyzer and raw run outputs remain unchanged.
